etym.s: [Zend tav, ‘to be able’; Lat. tumour, tueri, totus.]

spans.s: 2. तु॑ ind. (never found at the beginning of a sentence or verse; metrically also तू॑, RV.; cf. Pāṇ. vi, 3, 133) pray! I beg, do, now, then, Lat.dum used (esp. with the Imper.), RV.
but (also with एव॑ or वै॑ following), AV. iv, 18, 6; TS.; ŚBr. &c.
often incorrectly written for नु, MBh. (i, 6151 B. and C.)
sometimes used as a mere expletive
— न तु it is true — but not, ere — than
